title: 2014 AMC 10A Problem 2
statement: Roy’s cat eats \(\dfrac{1}{3}\) of a can of cat food every morning and \(\dfrac{1}{4}\) of a can of cat food every evening. Before feeding his cat on Monday morning, Roy opened a box containing \(6\) cans of cat food. On what day of the week did the cat finish eating all the cat food in the box?

solutions.text:
The cat eats \[ \dfrac{1}{3} + \dfrac{1}{4} = \dfrac{7}{12} \] cans of food each full day. After \(10\) full days, it has eaten \(10\cdot\frac7{12}=\frac{35}{6}\) cans, leaving \(\frac16\) of a can.

The cat finishes that remainder during its next morning feeding. The eleventh morning, counting Monday as the first, is Thursday.

Thus, C is the correct answer.
hints: The cat eats \(\frac7{12}\) can per full day
Check the integer day when the total first reaches \(6\) cans
